title: Known-likelihood Bernoulli GLM posterior sampling
current_best_explanation: No current global winner has been verified on this exact frozen input, split and scorer. A published dataset name or broad leaderboard lead is insufficient.
executed_endpoint: All ten original sbibm Bernoulli spiking-GLM observations, 100 × 10 design and 100 binary spikes, correlated Gaussian prior, explicit logistic likelihood. Return 10000 posterior draws. Custom primary C2ST uses 2000 subsampled draws, chance 0.5; secondary prior-whitened sliced Wasserstein-2.

existing_reference.name: Local Polya–Gamma Gibbs plus Laplace; original author posterior samples are scoring reference
existing_reference.evidence: A: local matched-likelihood comparator, finite chains only.
existing_reference.strength: Problem-specific PG conditional updates are mathematically exact and efficient; unlike amortized SBI they exploit the provided likelihood.
problems: Finite chains are not exact posterior guarantees.
Local PG and source reference use related algorithms, so independent sampler validation matters.
Original source chain initialized at truth; local comparator does not.
C2ST near/below chance cannot rank tiny differences as substantive gains.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

candidates.information_match: Can use simulator, but simulation-trained amortization adds budget absent from this known-likelihood task.

candidates.evidence: C: current primary joint-flow method with sbibm coverage.
candidates.information_match: Must verify raw vs sufficient-statistic GLM and common prior/design/observations; no imported aggregate C2ST.

candidates.name: GenSBI flow/score joint estimators
candidates.evidence: C: current author methods and benchmark docs.
candidates.information_match: Published x=10 sufficient-statistic GLM differs from this raw-spike interface; exact matching/retraining needed.

candidates.name: DynaMEchs
candidates.evidence: D: requested name unresolved as a relevant method.
candidates.information_match: Search finds multibody dynamics software; do not conflate it with SBI or claim a cognitive benchmark result.

recommended_next_comparator: Independent exact-likelihood NUTS/HMC and well-diagnosed PG sensitivity, keeping the same observations and canonical scorer; neural SBI only in a separate simulation-budget track.
switching_assessment: RETAIN PG as a strong matched specialist, add an independent sampler check, Tier B/C. No evidence supports replacing it with a newer amortized neural method on this tiny known-likelihood problem. Report posterior discrepancies and convergence jointly, not C2ST winner labels near chance.
limitations: Synthetic numerical observations are not biological cohorts.
C2ST is classifier- and sample-count-dependent; original leaderboard numbers are not this metric.
Target chance is 0.5; lower numerical values below chance are noise, despite frozen lower-is-better policy.
Source-reference algorithm dependence and finite reference error remain.
Original SBI simulation budgets and GPU training are not comparable to one 180-second CPU sampler.
Exact-name DynaMEchs relevance unresolved after bounded searches.

evidence_tiers.A: Locally executed and audited on this frozen protocol; establishes a comparator result, not universal optimality.
evidence_tiers.B: Primary method/benchmark with relevant task evidence but an unmatched split, inputs, scorer or budget.
evidence_tiers.C: Author repository, preprint, mathematical proposal or adaptation requiring additional validation.
evidence_tiers.D: Unresolved access, unavailable artifacts or input mismatch precludes an executable recommendation.

execution_policy: Literature review only. No inference, fitting, new scores, checkpoint downloads, frozen protocol edits or result changes. Any new comparator requires a prospective amendment, frozen training-only selection and separate result records.
score_import_policy: No unmatched published numbers were imported into benchmark scores.
